verdict.rationale: OpenHands advertises automations that detect failed CI workflows or security alerts, inspect the cause, and open a PR with a fix (openhands-docs-9, openhands-docs-10), which is a generic 'quality gate' auto-fix capability, but there is no evidence of a specific 'agent-readiness criteria' check (e.g., AGENTS.md, MCP config, repo scaffolding) being scanned or auto-remediated. missing for 10: explicit agent-readiness scoring/criteria definition, evidence of detecting and fixing those specific gates, and confirmation this maps to engineering-lead quality-gate workflows rather than generic CI/security fixes.
